The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c8176d1671beb83d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let α > 1, and suppose A is a c-additive α-approximation algorithm for metric k-median. For every η > 0, there is an ordinary (α + η)-approximation algorithm with running time nO(c/η) times the running time of A. For fixed α, c, η, this is polynomial overhead.
